summary: The United States may strike Iran's underground nuclear facility at Mount Al-Mul within 24 hours, per a senior American official. European diplomats were attacked by Israeli settlers near Taybeh in the West Bank, prompting IDF and police investigations. Israeli forces eliminated four Hamas operatives in Gaza, including a participant in the October 7 assault.
key_points: US may attack Iranian nuclear site "Mount Al-Mul" within 24 hours, senior official tells Global Eye. (Source: @yediotnews25/136375)
French, Belgian, Polish diplomats attacked by masked settlers near Taybeh; Belgian vehicle damaged, French mayor injured. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8483)
IDF kills four Hamas terrorists in Gaza including Oct 7 infiltrator Adham Khalil Muhammad Maarouf. (Source: @yediotnews25/136368)
Israeli helicopters seen in Syria's As-Suwayda region near Yarmouk River, landing per Syrian reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/136374)
Explosion near Sabaa Abkar, Baghdad; blast heard in Strait of Hormuz; Bushehr naval forces evacuated. (Source: @shin_persian/11217, @shin_persian/11215, @shin_persian/11212)
Oil tanker hit by mine in Hormuz, two tankers targeted by RPG near Saudi Arabia; UKMTO warnings issued. (Source: @yediotnews25/136365)
UAE resumes payments to Yemeni government forces; Saudi Arabia to provide air cover; Israel shared anti-Houthi intel. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8485, @Faytuks_Network/8478)
US embassy warns citizens in Saudi Arabia of possible airport attacks, airspace closures, flight disruptions. (Source: @yediotnews25/136369)

points: Bushehr naval forces ordered evacuation and heightened readiness per Iranian monitoring sources with 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/11212)
Blast heard in Strait of Hormuz; delayed post from Iranian monitoring network indicates possible maritime incident. (Source: @shin_persian/11215)
IRGC conducted shooting training at coordinates 29.6632, 52.5775 in Ziba Shahr, Fars Province on October 15, 2026. (Source: @shin_persian/11203)
Mi-171E helicopter refueled at base coordinates 29.66953, 52.574077 in Ziba Shahr, Fars Province per delayed tracking. (Source: @shin_persian/11213)
Several flights between Tehran and Bandar Abbas canceled for the week in Hormozgan Province per Iranian aviation notices. (Source: @shin_persian/11206)
Iranian authorities reportedly instructed citizens to prepare for widespread internet disruptions or complete shutdown. (Source: @yediotnews25/136367)
IRGC spokesperson responded to MOAB reports: "Only a barbaric civilization could use the sacred word 'mother' to name its most powerful bomb." (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8487)

IDF spokesperson condemned violence against European diplomats near Taybeh in Benjamin Brigade; police and forensics entered under IDF security; tour not coordinated with IDF. (Source: @yediotnews25/136362)

President Herzog called photographer Heidi Levine attacked in Benjamin, apologized, condemned "shocking violence phenomenon" not representing Israeli citizens. (Source: @N12chat/230423)

IDF eliminated four Hamas operatives in Gaza: Adham Khalil Muhammad Maarouf (Oct 7 infiltrator), Mahmoud Khaled Muhammad Madhun (Nukhba, anti-tank), Abida Suhail Hamad Martaja (sniper), Abdul Qader Guda. (Source: @yediotnews25/136368)
Hamas admits political bureau director Ali Al-Amoudi survived assassination attempt two weeks ago in western Gaza City, moderately wounded. (Source: @yediotnews25/136365)
IDF crossed border in southern Golan and Quneitra with drones, set up temporary checkpoint, returned to Israeli territory. (Source: @yediotnews25/136365)
